harness: One API request per batch of up to 10 trials: one user message holding the round's instructions unchanged and the batch's packets; no system prompt, no tools, no web. Every response is saved with the model and provider that served it (Google for all). A first run at effort high, without a cap, thought until the 32,768-token output limit and returned no answers in 40 batches; it was discarded and all 66 batches were run again with thinking capped.
run_settings: Reasoning max_tokens 20,000, max 32,000 output tokens; 66 batches. Re-runs: 1 batch, once (answered 9 of 10 trials).
